name: server-step-grammar

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which cover only this project's files; the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, because setting `inputs` replaces them. The tests read files elsewhere: they compare the JSON Schema generated from the Zod schemas with the step schemas the Interaction API contract publishes under apps/docs-site/public/interaction, they validate with the contract's Ajv set-up (hence `ajv` and `ajv-formats`), and the exhaustiveness test compiles a sample with the TypeScript compiler and the base tsconfig (hence `typescript` and tsconfig.base.json). The shared test vectors arrive through ^default (shared-test-vectors' `default` input). Without these entries a change to one of those files would replay a cached pass.

vectors-export.description: Write test-vectors/interaction/steps.json, the Interaction API contract's step examples as shared test vectors, with what each transport's mapper makes of them. A test fails when the committed file differs.
